All identified contacts have correct basic information (name, email, company, title). PROJECTS: Identified all 4 main projects with good descriptions and correct contact associations. Added 1 extra project (recrutement associé) which is mentioned in Philippe Dumont's topics but not as a standalone project in ground truth. TERMINOLOGY: Captured 12 definitions, matching 8 from ground truth exactly and adding 4 new ones (Data room, Conditions suspensives, Séquestre, Kbis, Golden parachute, AMF) that are contextually relevant. Major precision issues: (1) Systematically assigned 'semi-formal' tone to nearly all contacts when ground truth specifies 'formal' for everyone, (2) Changed Philippe Dumont's type from 'colleague' to 'manager' (reasonable interpretation but not matching ground truth), (3) Missing complete company name for Sophie Renard ('Étude Renard' in ground truth, null in output), (4) Missing title for Dominique Perrin ('Avocat au Barreau de Paris' in ground truth, null in output). The output added 'frequent_topics' section which is useful but not in ground truth schema.
